Execution_Steps: 1. Accelerate into round-off back handspring. 2. Punch floor vertically, driving arms straight overhead. 3. Maintain rigid straight-body hollow line throughout entire 360° backward rotation. 4. Spot floor and stick landing cleanly.
Common_Faults: Bending knees | Piking at hips | Throwing head back
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Layout on Floor | Gymnastics Acrobatics

Skill_Name: A dance passage with minimum of two different leaps, jumps, hop. 1 must be 180 split
Description: Gymfest Level 6 Platinum: Dance passage with minimum of 2 different leaps, jumps, or hops directly or indirectly connected, with at least one hitting full 180° split.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Full 180 split at peak | Continuous movement | Upright posture
Execution_Steps: 1. Connect two distinct dance elements with continuous rhythm. 2. Achieve full 180° cross or side split on at least one element. 3. Land softly in plie and step out with elegance.
Common_Faults: Split under 180° | Pausing between dance skills
Video_Tutorial_Title: Floor Dance Passage Series Tutorial (180 Split)

Skill_Name: A 360 degree turn on one foot
Description: Gymfest Level 6 Platinum: 360° turn on single support leg in high relevé with pointed passé foot.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Highest relevé possible | Spot the turn | Tight core
Execution_Steps: 1. Plie into preparation. 2. Rise to high relevé on supporting foot, snapping free foot to passé. 3. Spot wall, whip head 360° and lock landing spot. 4. Finish with control on relevé.
Common_Faults: Dropping heel mid-turn | Incomplete rotation
Video_Tutorial_Title: 360 Degree Turn on One Foot in Relevé

Description: Gymfest Level 6 Platinum: Acro pass featuring an aerial cartwheel, aerial walkover, or punch salto with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Maximum flight height | Clean rotation | Stick landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Accelerate into acro element. 2. Execute no-handed aerial or punch salto with full rotation. 3. Spot landing and stick in demi-plié.
Common_Faults: Touching hands down | Under-rotating
Video_Tutorial_Title: Side Aerial & Salto Acro Elements on Floor

Description: Gymfest Level 6 Platinum: Front handspring step-out rebounding directly into forward tucked punch salto.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast handspring block | Immediate punch rebound | Tuck tight around shins
Execution_Steps: 1. Hurdle into front handspring. 2. Block off hands and punch floor balls of feet. 3. Drive arms and hips up into front tuck somersault. 4. Spot floor, open and stick.
Common_Faults: Hesitation on punch | Low hip elevation
Video_Tutorial_Title: Front Handspring into Front Tuck Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Gymfest Level 6 Vault (Page 1): Front handspring with 180° twist off table (half-off vault) or round-off onto springboard table entry.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Block first then twist | Spot vault table on landing | Stick with locked knees
Execution_Steps: 1. Sprint down runway with top speed. 2. Punch springboard into straight pre-flight. 3. Block off table through shoulders, initiating 1/2 twist from core. 4. Spot table and stick landing facing back.
Common_Faults: Twisting before blocking | Piking hips during twist
Video_Tutorial_Title: Front Handspring on Vault Progression (Half-Off)

Skill_Name: Handspring front salto in the layout position / Running front layout
Description: Gymfest Level 7 Platinum: Running approach or front handspring connected into straight-body forward punch layout salto to stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift hips high over head | Lock body straight | Stick landing with chest high
Execution_Steps: 1. Sprint forward into low, aggressive hurdle punch. 2. Drive arms and chest upward into high forward trajectory. 3. Maintain hollow straight alignment as hips rotate forward over shoulders. 4. Spot floor on descent and stick landing softly.
Common_Faults: Piking at hips | Diving forward low to mat
Video_Tutorial_Title: How To Do A Front Layout (Gymnastics Tutorial)

Skill_Name: Front handspring Full turn / Round off
Description: Gymfest Level 7 Vault (Page 1): Front handspring repulsion off table with complete 360° longitudinal twist (full-twist off table) or Tsukahara round-off entry.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Explosive repulsion block | Wrap arms across chest for full twist | Spot landing mat to stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Maximum speed runway sprint. 2. Punch springboard into strong pre-flight. 3. Block through shoulders off vault table. 4. Execute full 360° longitudinal twist in post-flight before sticking on mat.
Common_Faults: Twisting on table prematurely | Under-twisting on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Front Handspring Full Turn & Yurchenko Drills on Vault

Description: Gymfest Level 8 Platinum: Complete optional floor exercise routine choreography meeting all composition requirements: multiple saltos, 180° dance passage, and 360° turn.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Artistry and presentation | High execution tumbling | Stuck landings throughout
Execution_Steps: 1. Perform introductory choreography to music. 2. Execute primary tumbling pass (e.g. RO-BHS-Layout Full). 3. Perform connected dance passage with 180° split leap. 4. Execute secondary acro pass and stick finish salute.
Common_Faults: Loss of rhythm with music | Stepping out of bounds
Video_Tutorial_Title: Optional Floor Routine Composition & Tumbling Passes

Description: Gymfest Level 8 Vault (Page 1): Tsukahara (1/4 to 1/2 turn entry into back salto) or Yurchenko (round-off onto board, back handspring onto table into post-flight salto).
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast runway sprint | Violent repulsion block off table | Hold tight hollow post-flight
Execution_Steps: 1. Run with top speed down runway. 2. Execute round-off onto board (Yurchenko) or 1/2 turn entry (Tsukahara). 3. Block violently through shoulders off vault table. 4. Fly into backward layout somersault and stick on landing mat.
Common_Faults: Slow hurdle punch | Collapsing arms on table
Video_Tutorial_Title: Tsuk Vault Drills Progression & Journey

Description: Front support on low bar, lean shoulders forward, drive legs back and hollow core to elevate hips 20° off bar.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lock elbows straight | Hollow chest | Keep toes pointed together
Execution_Steps: 1. Start in locked front support with straight arms. 2. Shift shoulders slightly forward over the bar. 3. Drive feet and hips back into a tight hollow cast. 4. Return smoothly to front support without banging thighs.
Common_Faults: Bending elbows | Arching back on cast | Piking too early on return
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Cast on Bars | Beginner Drills

Skill_Name: Straight Arm Hang to Candlestick Hold
Description: Straight arm hang from high or low bar, lift straight legs upward into inverted candlestick position with toes to bar.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Active shoulders | Straight knees | Control the descent
Execution_Steps: 1. Hang with overhand grip with shoulders active. 2. Engage lats and lift legs with straight knees. 3. Raise hips to bar level holding tight vertical body line. 4. Lower with controlled eccentric strength.
Common_Faults: Swinging excessively | Bending knees | Dropping down abruptly
Video_Tutorial_Title: Bar Core & Hanging Candlestick Drills

Description: Chin-up arm flexion, dynamic leg drive overhead pulling hips to bar, and wrist shift into front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Chin to bar first | Pull hips into bar | Shift wrists on top | Tall locked chest
Execution_Steps: 1. Hang with overgrip, initiate with a strong flexed-arm chin pull bringing chin over bar. 2. Drive knees or straight legs overhead, pulling hips tight against the bar. 3. Rotate hips over the bar while shifting wrists from hang to front support position. 4. Push tall into locked front support with shoulders over bar and legs tight.
Common_Faults: Arms straightening during kickover | Hips drifting away from bar | Failing to roll wrists forward
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Pullover on Bars | Gymnastics Step by Step

Description: Front support cast elevating hips 30° above bar with tight hollow posture and locked arms.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Kick heels up | Eyes on bar | Lock elbows
Execution_Steps: 1. Hold front support with arms locked. 2. Dip hips and kick heels back and up. 3. Hit 30° hollow line with eyes on bar. 4. Absorb back to bar in front support.
Common_Faults: Arching back | Bending elbows
Video_Tutorial_Title: Casting Drills for Level 2 Bars

Description: Small cast away from bar, snap hips into bar, rotate backward 360° around bar returning to front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Glue hips to the bar | Head neutral (look at toes) | Fast wrist shift on top | Stay stiff like a pencil
Execution_Steps: 1. Perform a preliminary cast to clear hips from bar. 2. As body returns, glue thighs/hips to the bar with head neutral and body straight. 3. Drop backward like a statue, using momentum to rotate 360° around the bar. 4. Shift wrists dynamically on top to finish in tall front support.
Common_Faults: Throwing head back | Hips peeling away mid-circle | Bending knees
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to do a Back Hip Circle | Step-by-Step Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Jump to overgrip on low bar, pike glide forward inches off mat, fully open body line at peak, and swing back.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Straight arms locked | Pike on way out | Shoot toes forward at full extension | Keep chin neutral
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand arm distance behind low bar, jump forward to catch bar with overhand grip. 2. Pike legs smoothly at hips with straight knees, sliding toes just inches off the floor mat. 3. At peak forward swing, open shoulders and extend hips fully into an open hollow body line. 4. Pull heels and hips back toward bar on backswing with straight arms engaged.
Common_Faults: Bending knees during glide | Feet scraping the floor | Failing to extend at forward peak
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Master the Glide Swing on Bars | Key Drills

Description: From front support, drive heels backward-upward with straight arms, elevating hips 30° to 45° off the bar.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Press down with palms | Straight elbows locked | Drive with toes | Keep chest hollow
Execution_Steps: 1. Begin in locked front support with straight arms and rounded upper back. 2. Bend slightly at the hips to load momentum while keeping arms locked straight. 3. Explosively drive toes and heels backward and upward while pressing downward with hands. 4. Reach a minimum 30° angle with hips clear of the bar before returning softly.
Common_Faults: Bent elbows absorbing power | Arching back instead of hollow cast | Hips remaining touching the bar
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Cast on Uneven Bars | Level 3 & Silver Cast Drills

Description: Cast from front support, pike hips underneath the bar, open into hollow arch dismount over mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar away on cast | Hollow drop | Shoot feet to the ceiling | Spot the landing mat
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute a cast to 30°, then drop into an undershoot under the bar keeping hips close. 2. Maintain eye contact with feet as body swings forward under the bar. 3. Shoot toes up toward ceiling and release bar with both hands simultaneously. 4. Land softly in demi-plié with chest upright and stick without stepping.
Common_Faults: Releasing too early or late | Piking on landing | Cowboying knees on dismount
Video_Tutorial_Title: Undershoot Dismount Tutorial | Level 3 Uneven Bars

Description: Piked glide forward, toes snap to bar at extension, dynamic hip drive pulling bar to waist into front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Big open glide at the front | Toes to bar fast on return | Shins slide the bar | Wrist shift on top!
Execution_Steps: 1. Jump from mat into a long, powerful glide swing with legs straight and toes off floor. 2. Extend fully at forward peak, opening chest and hips into hollow body. 3. On backswing, pull toes rapidly to the bar while keeping arms straight. 4. Slide shins up the bar, shift wrists aggressively over bar and press tall into front support.
Common_Faults: Piking on forward glide | Bending elbows when pulling toes up | Failing to roll wrists forward
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Kip on Uneven Bars | The Ultimate Coaching Guide

Description: Dynamic heel drive from front support with shoulders over rail, elevating straight body line to horizontal (0°-15°).
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push down hard through palms | Straight elbows never bend | Drive heels above horizontal | Keep core locked
Execution_Steps: 1. Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded hollow upper body. 2. Load with a slight hip drop without bending elbows. 3. Press downward with palms while driving heels and toes upward past horizontal. 4. Hit horizontal line with toes pointed and return smoothly to bar.
Common_Faults: Casting below horizontal | Arched back casting | Bent arms
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Cast to Horizontal and Handstand | Bars Drills

Skill_Name: Clear Hip Circle to Horizontal (Back Free Hip)
Description: Cast away from bar, drop hips without touching rail, circle backward in hollow shape, open to horizontal.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar away on drop | Keep arms locked straight | Open shoulders on the rise | Look at toes then spot bar
Execution_Steps: 1. Cast to horizontal, drop backward keeping straight arms pushing bar down. 2. Do not let hips rest on the bar; maintain hollow curve 2-4 inches off bar. 3. Rotate under bar and pull bar into hips momentarily, then push bar away. 4. Shoot open to horizontal or above on rise with arms locked straight.
Common_Faults: Resting hips on bar (turning it into a back hip circle) | Bent arms | Dropping head back
Video_Tutorial_Title: Clear Hip Circle on Uneven Bars | Level 4/5 Technique Drills

Skill_Name: Squat-on / Pike-on to High Bar Jump
Description: Cast from low bar, place balls of feet between hands on rail (squat or pike), stand and jump to catch high bar.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift hips high on cast | Light feet on the bar | Spot high bar with eyes | Catch high bar with straight arms
Execution_Steps: 1. Cast from low bar, lift hips high above bar level with straight arms. 2. Place balls of feet softly on the low bar between or outside hands. 3. Stand up with chest rising and eyes spotting the high bar overhead. 4. Jump forward and upward to catch high bar in solid overgrip with straight arms.
Common_Faults: Feet slipping off low bar | Jumping before standing balanced | Bent arm catch on high bar
Video_Tutorial_Title: Squat On and Jump to High Bar Tutorial | Uneven Bars

Skill_Name: Tuck Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
Description: Tap swing on high bar, release at front apex, execute backward tucked salto rotation and stick landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Kick toes to the ceiling | Release on the rise | Tuck tight around shins | Spot mat and open to stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute dynamic tap swings on high bar, creating high hollow-to-arch momentum. 2. On front swing, drive toes upward past horizontal toward ceiling. 3. Release the bar at 45° angle, pull knees tightly to chest in tucked somersault. 4. Spot landing mat, open tuck and stick firmly with arms in salute.
Common_Faults: Releasing too early (flying backward low) | Releasing too late (flying straight up into bar) | Loose tuck
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Flyaway on Bars | Progressive Drills & Safety

Description: Dynamic cast straight into 180° vertical handstand on high or low bar with zero hip angle deduction.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar down aggressively | Open shoulders all the way | Heels drive straight to ceiling | Lock ribs flat
Execution_Steps: 1. Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded upper back. 2. Lower slightly into hollow load and press down vigorously through palms. 3. Drive heels upward and open shoulders over hands into vertical handstand line. 4. Lock ribs, squeeze glutes, and hold vertical momentarily before returning or circling.
Common_Faults: Bent arms | Arching back (banana back) over vertical | Casting short below 45°
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Cast to Handstand on Uneven Bars | Pro Drills

Skill_Name: Giant Circle (Back Giant on High Bar)
Description: 360° rotation around high bar with straight arms and body passing through vertical handstand at apex.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Stay long and straight on drop | Tap through the bottom | Shift wrists on top | Hit handstand line at peak
Execution_Steps: 1. Cast to handstand on high bar, fall forward in long straight-body extension. 2. Pass under bar maintaining straight arms and tap heels through bottom. 3. On upswing, hollow chest and shift wrists over top of bar. 4. Kick heels through vertical handstand at apex and continue or prepare dismount.
Common_Faults: Bending arms at the bottom | Piking too early on upswing | Failing to shift wrists resulting in peel-off
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Giant Swing on Uneven Bars | Level 7 & Platinum

Skill_Name: Layout Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
Description: High bar swing with tap, release into stretched layout backward salto with stick landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Strong heel drive on front swing | Release at 45° angle | Keep body locked like a board | Spot mat to stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Build momentum with high tap swing from giant circle or long hang cast. 2. At bottom of front swing, execute a sharp hollow tap driving heels upward. 3. Release bar as toes reach 45° above horizontal, holding body completely straight. 4. Spot the mat, absorb landing in solid stuck position with arms raised.
Common_Faults: Piking or tucking knees (downgrade to tuck flyaway) | Releasing too early or late | Arching over on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Layout Flyaway on Bars Tutorial | Perfect Technique & Safety

Skill_Name: Pak Salto Transition to Low Bar
Description: Cast handstand on high bar, swing down and release into backward stretched salto between bars to catch low bar in hang.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Late tap | Keep layout open | Eyes on low bar rail
Execution_Steps: 1. Cast to handstand on high bar. 2. Swing forward, tap and release backward into layout salto. 3. Spot low bar rail during flight. 4. Catch low bar with arms straight and swing through.
Common_Faults: Piking in flight | Over-rotating past low bar
Video_Tutorial_Title: Pak Salto Progression on Bars

Skill_Name: Jump to Front Support Mount on Beam
Description: Stand facing beam, jump placing both hands on surface, press into balanced front support with tall chest and pointed toes.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push tall into palms | Knees straight and locked | Eyes focused on far end of beam
Execution_Steps: 1. Place hands flat on beam shoulder-width apart, fingers wrapping sides. 2. Punch springboard and push down through palms to elevate hips above beam. 3. Extend shoulders over hands in locked front support with legs glued together. 4. Swing right leg over beam into straddle or squat position with graceful posture.
Common_Faults: Shoulders sagging | Banging thighs on beam surface | Loose feet
Video_Tutorial_Title: Beam Mounts for Beginners & Silver Level

Description: Stand on one foot in releve or flat, lift rear leg straight to 30° minimum holding balance for 2 seconds with artistic arms.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lock supporting knee | Lift back leg | Chest proud
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand tall with supporting leg locked. 2. Lift back leg smoothly with pointed toe. 3. Hold stationary for 2 seconds with chest lifted. 4. Lower with elegance to beam.
Common_Faults: Bending supporting knee | Dropping chest forward
Video_Tutorial_Title: Arabesque & Balance Holds on Beam

Description: Step into lunge, place hands side by side on beam, kick to 45° English handstand, tap toes together and step down.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Thumbs on top | Lock elbows | Step down in lunge
Execution_Steps: 1. Lunge on beam, arms by ears. 2. Reach hands to beam with thumbs on top, fingers gripping sides. 3. Kick to 45° with tight straight legs. 4. Step down one foot at a time into clean lunge.
Common_Faults: Over-kicking off beam | Bent elbows
Video_Tutorial_Title: Handstand on Balance Beam | Progression & Safety

Skill_Name: Cross Handstand on Beam (Min 45° to Vertical)
Description: Kick into handstand perpendicular or crosswise on beam, bringing legs together at minimum 45° angle to vertical with straight body alignment.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Reach long in lever | Thumbs touching | Squeeze butt and ribs | Step back into deep lunge
Execution_Steps: 1. Start in deep beam lunge with arms by ears and torso aligned with front leg. 2. Reach far out, placing thumbs touching across the beam with fingers wrapped around sides. 3. Kick back leg up while levering body into a vertical or minimum 45° cross handstand. 4. Step down with dominant foot first into a clean beam lunge, arms finished in crown.
Common_Faults: Rushing the kickover without levering | Crooked hand placement causing beam slip | Falling off on step-down
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Handstand on Beam | Safe Drills & Confidence

Description: Straight line cartwheel placing hands hand-over-hand along beam axis, kicking through vertical straddle to lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Keep shoulders in line of beam | Spot hands onto beam | Lock knees at vertical | Step down along center
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand in tall lunge on beam, sight the target spot 2 feet in front of toes. 2. Lever down placing lead hand turned inward, follow with second hand directly along center line. 3. Kick back leg strongly over top, passing through a vertical straddle plane with straight legs. 4. Land first foot on center line, immediately followed by second foot in a steady lunge.
Common_Faults: Missing center line with second hand | Piking hips out of beam plane | Rushing landing and falling sideways
Video_Tutorial_Title: Cartwheel on Beam Tutorial | Step by Step Breakdown

Description: Explosive jump off two feet along beam axis, separating legs into equal 60°-90° split with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Jump UP before splitting | Equal split front and back | Chest stays upright | Absorb landing in plie
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand with one foot slightly in front of the other, knees relaxed. 2. Plie through both feet and jump straight upward with arms swinging into side-middle or crown. 3. Split front and back leg simultaneously to at least 90° separation with pointed toes. 4. Pull legs together quickly on descent to land front-foot back-foot with soft knees.
Common_Faults: Leaning chest forward | Uneven leg split (front leg high, back leg low) | Landing stiff-legged
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Split Jump on Beam | Tips for Balance & Height

Description: Step into releve on one foot with other foot in passé, execute 180° rotation with tight core and upright carriage.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Stay tall in relevé | Spot the end of beam | Squeeze inner thighs | Core engaged
Execution_Steps: 1. Step forward onto the ball of one foot in high relevé, arms in first or fifth position. 2. Spot a focal point at opposite end of the beam to lock balance. 3. Turn head and shoulders 180° while pivoting cleanly on ball of foot. 4. Finish in locked relevé before lowering heel into preparation for next skill.
Common_Faults: Dropping heel mid-turn | Wobbling arms out of alignment | Turning off-axis
Video_Tutorial_Title: Beam Pivot Turns Tutorial | Perfect Balance in Relevé

Skill_Name: Round-off Dismount off End of Beam
Description: Hurdle step along beam, place hands in T-position at beam end, snap legs together through vertical, rebound off end and stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Drive the hurdle along center line | Push beam away with hands | Snap feet down together | Stick landing firmly
Execution_Steps: 1. Lunge along beam line approaching the dismount end with confident momentum. 2. Place hands in line near the end of the beam, kicking legs over with aggressive snap. 3. Push off beam with hands, snapping legs together before passing end of beam. 4. Land facing beam on landing mat, absorbing impact in demi-plié with arms presented.
Common_Faults: Looking down at hands and under-rotating | Releasing hands prematurely | Landing too close to beam
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Round Off Dismount on Beam

Description: One-foot lifted bridge back along center line of beam, hands placed with thumbs together, kicking trailing leg smoothly over.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift leg before arching | Keep arms glued to ears | Hands thumb-to-thumb | Hold finish lunge solid
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand tall on beam with lead leg extended front and arms by ears. 2. Lift lead leg while arching backward through upper spine, eyes watching hands. 3. Place hands thumb-to-thumb on center line of beam with open shoulders. 4. Kick back foot up and through a full 180° split, stepping down softly in lunge.
Common_Faults: Dropping hands off center line | Insufficient leg split under 120° | Wobbling on landing step-out
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Back Walkover on Beam | Balance & Alignment

Skill_Name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Acro Prep)
Description: Dynamic sit and jump backward along beam axis, hands contacting center line with flight, stepping out to lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Sit back before jumping | Look for beam between hands | Snap lead foot down on line | Stand tall into lunge
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand on beam with feet aligned, sit back as if into a chair with arms swinging. 2. Jump backward aggressively, extending through hips and driving arms by ears. 3. Place hands in line on beam, blocking through shoulders while splitting legs. 4. Step lead foot down along center line followed by back foot into secure lunge.
Common_Faults: Jumping crooked off center | Short undercutting jump causing head crash | Bent arms on hand impact
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Handspring on Balance Beam Tutorial | Fear-Free Drills

Description: Forward step and elevation off one foot, splitting legs in air to minimum 120° with straight knees and upright chest.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Brush foot along beam | Split evenly at apex | Chest tall and proud | Land softly on center line
Execution_Steps: 1. Step smoothly along beam with upright core and confident vision. 2. Brush front foot forward aggressively while pushing through back ball of foot. 3. Reach a minimum 120° split at peak height with torso vertical. 4. Land on front foot in demi-plié along center line with trailing leg controlled.
Common_Faults: Leaning forward on take-off | Split less than 120° | Landing off center line of beam
Video_Tutorial_Title: Mastering Split Leaps on Beam | Height, Split & Consistency

Description: Hurdle or step forward toward end of beam, two-foot punch, forward tucked salto in air, sticking landing on 8" mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Punch off toes at end of beam | Jump UP before tucking | Grab shins tight | Spot mat and stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Approach end of beam with confident step-hurdle punch off balls of feet. 2. Drive arms and hips upward into a high forward somersault takeoff. 3. Tuck knees tightly to chest with hands grabbing shins. 4. Spot landing mat, open out of tuck and stick firmly in demi-plié.
Common_Faults: Diving forward instead of upward | Slow opening causing deep squat or fall | Stumbling forward on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Front Tuck Dismount off Beam | Safe Progressions

Skill_Name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Flight Acro)
Description: Official flight acro requirement on balance beam: complete flight phase before hand contact, stepping out in rhythm.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Sit back before leaping | Spot hands onto beam line | Aggressive shoulder block | Hold finish lunge motionless
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand in tall aligned posture on beam, sit hips back in controlled hinge. 2. Drive through legs into backwards jump with arms sweeping past ears. 3. Block through palms on beam line while opening legs in split step-out. 4. Land first foot on center line, followed immediately by second foot in a locked lunge.
Common_Faults: Jumping crooked off beam | Bending elbows on hand contact | Flipping head back and missing line
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Handspring Step-Out on Beam | Fear Breakdown & Drills

Description: No-handed cartwheel along beam axis: powerful hurdle punch, torso dip and heel kick through vertical, landing on beam.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Deep lunge drive | Violent back leg kick | Keep chest aligned with beam | Spot the beam for landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Take a confident step into deep lunge on beam with chest driving forward. 2. Drive lead leg down into beam while kicking back leg with maximum velocity overhead. 3. Keep chest up and arms pulled into body or crown, rotating without hand support. 4. Spot beam center line on landing, stepping lead foot down followed by back foot.
Common_Faults: Diving hands down toward beam in panic | Piking hips sideways | Landing crooked off center line
Video_Tutorial_Title: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam Tutorial | Drills & Confidence

Description: Round-off off beam end into stretched backward layout salto in air, landing in stuck position on mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Explosive rebound off beam end | Straight body alignment (no tuck or pike) | Spot the mat and stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Hurdle into round-off off end of beam, blocking through hands on the wood. 2. Rebound backwards and upward with body held straight as an arrow. 3. Rotate through 360° layout somersault with arms by ears or crossed on chest. 4. Spot the landing mat, open chest and stick firmly in demi-plié.
Common_Faults: Piking or tucking knees mid-air | Under-rotating into back step | Rebounding crooked off beam
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Layout Beam Dismount Tutorial | Level 7 & Platinum

Skill_Name: Back Handspring to Layout Step-out on Beam
Official_Reference: USAG L9 Beam Acro Flight Series
Description: Acro flight series: back handspring connected directly into stretched layout step-out without pause.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Immediate rebound | Keep hips square | Spot beam throughout
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute back handspring step-out along center line. 2. Rebound directly into backward layout jump without halting momentum. 3. Kick trailing leg through vertical layout step-out. 4. Step down into solid lunge balance.
Common_Faults: Pause between elements | Crooked alignment
Video_Tutorial_Title: BHS to Layout Step-out Series on Beam

Skill_Name: Kick to Handstand Flatback on 16" Mat Stack
Description: Take 3-4 steps, lunge onto floor, kick into vertical handstand with hands on edge of 16" mat stack, fall straight to flat back.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lock elbows | Heels together | Chin to chest on landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Short accelerated approach into deep lunge. 2. Place hands on front edge of 16" mat. 3. Kick to vertical handstand with heels together. 4. Hollow and fall flat onto back with chin tucked.
Common_Faults: Arching back | Bending elbows on mat contact
Video_Tutorial_Title: Handstand Flatback Progression for Level 1 Vault

Skill_Name: Run & Hurdle to Flatback on 24" Mat Stack
Description: Sprint 30-40ft, hurdle punch onto springboard, kick through handstand onto 24" mat stack, falling straight to flat back.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Low fast hurdle | Punch with balls of feet | Tight hollow body
Execution_Steps: 1. Run with forward acceleration. 2. Hurdle punch springboard with both feet simultaneously. 3. Reach hands to front edge of 24" mat stack. 4. Hit vertical and fall flat on back.
Common_Faults: Slowing down before springboard | Arching back on flatback
Video_Tutorial_Title: Springboard to Handstand Flatback Vault Drills

Description: Accelerated board hurdle into tight handstand with heel drive, falling straight to flat back on 32" mat stack.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast arm swing | Eyes on the board | Lock ribs flat | Pinch heels together
Execution_Steps: 1. Run with forward acceleration and hurdle onto the springboard with feet together. 2. Punch board explosively, punching arms up through ears into 45° entry toward mat stack. 3. Hit vertical handstand momentarily on front edge of 32" mat stack. 4. Hollow down and drop flat onto back with chin tucked.
Common_Faults: Arching through lower back on impact | Bending elbows on contact | Under-rotating
Video_Tutorial_Title: Handstand Flat Back Vault Technique & Drills

Skill_Name: Run & Hurdle onto Springboard to Straight Jump
Description: Consistent accelerated sprint, low hurdle onto sweet spot of the board, and explosive vertical straight jump with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Accelerate into board | Low fast hurdle | Punch the springs | Stick and hold 3 seconds
Execution_Steps: 1. Sprint 40-50 feet with upright sprinting mechanics and high knees, accelerating progressively. 2. Execute a low, forward-driven hurdle step off one foot without elevating excessively. 3. Punch both balls of feet simultaneously on the sweet spot (front third) of the springboard. 4. Drive arms straight up by ears, soaring into a tight hollow straight jump, and stick the landing on 8" mat.
Common_Faults: Decelerating before the hurdle | Jumping too high into the board | Dropping arms on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Run and Hurdle onto the Springboard | Vault Drills

Description: Official USAG Level 4-5 vault: accelerated run, punch springboard, pre-flight to table, shoulder block to post-flight and stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Full sprint acceleration | Fast shoulder block off table | Stay completely hollow | Stick landing firmly
Execution_Steps: 1. Sprint with maximum velocity down the 60-foot runway without stuttering. 2. Hurdle onto the springboard with arms driving backward to forward. 3. Hit board and punch into a straight pre-flight body angle of ~40° to the table. 4. Block explosively through shoulders on contact with the table and fly into stuck landing.
Common_Faults: Piking or arching on the table | Bending elbows during contact | Squatting on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Front Handspring Vault | Technique Breakdown

Skill_Name: Half-On Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Twist Entry)
Description: Hurdle onto board, initiate 1/4 to 1/2 twist in pre-flight, contact table in sideways handstand position, repel off to flatback/stand.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Twist from the core, not arms | Eyes spot hands on table | Explosive shoulder block | Tight hollow alignment
Execution_Steps: 1. Hurdle onto springboard with rapid arm drive. 2. Punch board and initiate 1/4 to 1/2 turn from hips and core during pre-flight. 3. Place hands staggered/turned on table to repel off in sideways-to-backward alignment. 4. Land on feet or back onto mat stack with body rigid.
Common_Faults: Twisting too early before leaving board | Collapsing support arm | Over-rotating off side of mat
Video_Tutorial_Title: Tsukahara & Half-On Vault Drills for Level 5 and Gold

Skill_Name: Front Handspring Half-Off Vault (1/2 Twist Off)
Description: Front handspring entry onto vault table, explosive shoulder block, 1/2 twist in post-flight, landing facing the vault table.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Block first, then twist | Keep arms close to body on twist | Spot vault table on landing | Stick with locked knees
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute maximum speed run and punch springboard into strong pre-flight. 2. Block aggressively off table through shoulders in straight body alignment. 3. Initiate 1/2 twist from hips and core during post-flight after clearing table. 4. Spot the vault table and stick landing facing back toward the apparatus.
Common_Faults: Twisting on the table before blocking | Piking hips during twist | Under-rotating into backwards step
Video_Tutorial_Title: Front Handspring Half Off Vault Breakdown & Post-Flight Drills

Skill_Name: Tsukahara Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Turn On)
Description: Round-off entry onto vault table with 1/2 turn on, explosive hand block into backward post-flight onto landing mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast board entry | Square shoulders to table on contact | Violent repulsion block | Tight hollow backward flight
Execution_Steps: 1. High-velocity run into aggressive springboard punch with arms driving up. 2. Turn 1/4 to 1/2 onto the table, placing first and second hand in cartwheel/round-off line. 3. Repel violently off the table through shoulders while snapping body straight. 4. Soar backward through air into solid upright landing on resi-mat.
Common_Faults: Turning too late off the board | Collapsing shoulder on hand contact | Piking on post-flight
Video_Tutorial_Title: Tsukahara Vault Drills & Progressions | Platinum Gymnastics

Description: 1/2 turn onto vault table followed by backward salto in piked or layout body shape with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Maximum speed | Repel off table | Hold straight body layout
Execution_Steps: 1. Sprint at 9.0+ m/s down runway. 2. Punch springboard into 1/2 turn on. 3. Block explosively off table into stretched post-flight layout. 4. Rotate 360° backward, spot landing and stick.
Common_Faults: Piking in layout | Late table contact
Video_Tutorial_Title: Tsukahara Layout Vault Breakdown

Description: Accelerated hurdle into round-off, snap legs together through vertical, violent block off hands and high hollow rebound stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Speed into hurdle | Hands in T-shape | Snap feet together fast | Explosive hollow rebound
Execution_Steps: 1. Power hurdle with chest leaning into travel direction. 2. Place hands in T-shape on center floor line. 3. Kick legs up through vertical and snap together at 12 o’clock with 1/2 turn. 4. Repel off hands into high vertical rebound, sticking landing without bounce.
Common_Faults: Crooked hand placement | Late snap down past vertical | Landing on heels and stepping
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Powerful Round-off on Floor | Rebound Drills

Description: Step into single-leg takeoff, elevate hips into equal 90° leg separation with straight knees and pointed toes, landing on front foot.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Brush foot along floor | Split at apex of jump | Keep chest over hips | Quiet toe-ball-heel landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Take a continuous step or chassé with upright carriage and pointed feet. 2. Brush lead foot forward through low battement, exploding off trailing leg. 3. Achieve minimum 90° leg split at the peak of elevation with chest held tall. 4. Land softly in plie on front foot and step out with elegance.
Common_Faults: Bent back knee | Dropping chest forward | Insufficient split under 90°
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Get Better Split Leaps | Drills for 180 and Height

Description: Fundamental tumbling pass for Level 4-5 / Xcel Gold: round-off into rapid back handspring rebound, set high into backward tucked salto.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast handspring into punch | Drive chest UP on takeoff | Tuck tight around shins | Spot floor and stick landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Run with acceleration into a powerful round-off with aggressive snap down. 2. Immediately rebound into a fast, long back handspring, keeping arms by ears. 3. Punch both feet off floor through toes, driving chest and arms straight up into the air. 4. Pull knees to chest in a tight tuck, rotate 360°, open body and stick the landing.
Common_Faults: Throwing head back on takeoff | Slow back handspring robbing height | Under-rotating into hands-down landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Round-Off Back Handspring Back Tuck Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Forward running approach, two-foot punch into high vertical set, rotating forward tucked salto to stick landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Punch hard off toes | Lift hips over shoulders | Tuck tight | Kick out before landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Run 3-4 steps with forward acceleration into a low, fast hurdle. 2. Punch both balls of feet simultaneously with arms lifting from hips past ears. 3. Lift hips high over head while tucking knees firmly into chest. 4. Spot floor on rotation, kick out of tuck and absorb landing with chest high.
Common_Faults: Diving forward with low hips | Cowboying knees wide | Landing in low squat
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Punch Front (Front Tuck) | Floor Gymnastics

Description: Forward leg swings to 45°, reverses explosively backward while trailing leg swings forward, achieving 120°+ split at apex.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Quick leg scissor in air | Chest stays upright and tall | Point both toes through switch | Land softly on front foot
Execution_Steps: 1. Take a step-chassé preparation with upright posture. 2. Swing lead leg forward to approximately 45° with straight knee and pointed toe. 3. Aggressively switch legs in mid-air, driving front leg back and back leg forward. 4. Hit peak split of 120°+ before landing softly in demi-plié on front foot.
Common_Faults: Swinging lead leg too high before switch | Dropping chest forward during split | Bent back leg on finish
Video_Tutorial_Title: Switch Leap Tutorial | How to Get a 180 Degree Switch Leap

Description: Round-off back handspring into explosive vertical takeoff, rotating backward in stretched hollow layout body line.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast round-off BHS transition | Punch straight UP | Hold body straight like a pencil | Spot floor and stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Accelerate through a long hurdle into powerful round-off and back handspring. 2. Punch both balls of feet, driving arms straight overhead into high backward trajectory. 3. Maintain rigid hollow body line throughout entire 360° backward rotation. 4. Spot the floor, extend through ankles and stick landing cleanly with no steps.
Common_Faults: Bending knees (turning it into a back tuck) | Piking at hips (piked layout) | Throwing head backward prematurely
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Back Layout on Floor | Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Round-off back handspring into high layout with 180° longitudinal twist initiated from high set, landing forward.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Flip first, then twist | Tight wrap across chest | Look over shoulder for spot | Land facing opposite direction
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute powerful round-off back handspring into vertical punch. 2. Rise into layout position with arms overhead. 3. At apex of salto, wrap arms into chest and initiate 1/2 twist from hips. 4. Spot landing facing backwards, absorb impact in demi-plié and stick.
Common_Faults: Twisting off the floor before lifting | Piking hips during twist | Under-twisting landing sideways
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Layout Half Twist Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

Skill_Name: Switch Leap to Tour Jeté Connection (Dance Series)
Description: Mandatory dance connection series: switch leap (180° split) connected in direct rhythm to 1/2 turning tour jeté leap.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Seamless rhythm between leaps | 180° split on both elements | Spot each landing | Maintain high artistic presentation
Execution_Steps: 1. Perform switch leap with full 180° leg split and upright chest. 2. Land on ball of front foot in plie and immediately step into tour jeté preparation. 3. Jump and turn 180° in mid-air while switching legs into reverse grand jeté. 4. Land softly in arabesque or fondue with expressive posture.
Common_Faults: Stutter step between leaps | Insufficient split angle under 180° | Losing balance on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Switch Leap & Tour Jeté Dance Connections | Gymnastics Artistry

Skill_Name: Double Turn (720° on One Foot on Floor)
Description: High difficulty pirouette on floor: step into high releve, execute two full 360° rotations (720°) on one foot in passé.
Key_Coaching_Cues: High relevé on big toe | Fast double spot with head | Squeeze core and inner thighs | Clean finish on relevé
Execution_Steps: 1. Step forward into preparation lunge, arms centered in first position. 2. Push sharply into high relevé on single support leg, snapping free leg to knee passé. 3. Whip head around twice in rapid spotting action to complete 720° rotation. 4. Lock hips and core, checking out cleanly on relevé before lowering heel.
Common_Faults: Dropping heel after first turn | Failing to spot causing dizziness/drifting | Under-rotating into uncontrolled fall
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Double Turn in Gymnastics & Dance | 720 Degree Turn

Description: Round-off back handspring into explosive high set, completing two full backward tucked saltos before landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Maximum set height | Hold tight tuck through two flips | Open on spot and stick
Execution_Steps: 1. High acceleration round-off into rapid back handspring. 2. Punch floor violently, driving chest and arms up to ceiling. 3. Pull knees tight into double tuck rotation. 4. Spot floor at 630°, open out of tuck and stick landing.
Common_Faults: Low set | Opening too early | Deep squat on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Double Back Tuck Technique & Progressions

Skill_Name: Blind Change (1/2 Pirouette on High Bar)
Description: Cast to handstand on high bar, turn 180° on one arm into reverse grip swinging down smoothly into front giant.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Reach vertical before turning | Keep hips square during 180° turn | Shift weight cleanly onto single post arm
Execution_Steps: 1. Cast to vertical handstand on high bar. 2. Shift weight onto turning hand while locking shoulder. 3. Release second hand and turn head and torso 180°. 4. Catch bar in underhand reverse grip at vertical and swing down into front giant.
Common_Faults: Turning before vertical (deduction) | Piking in handstand | Missing undergrip catch
Video_Tutorial_Title: How to Do a Blind Change on Uneven Bars

Skill_Name: Back Handspring to Back Handspring Series
Description: Mandatory acro flight series for Level 8: back handspring step-out connected with direct acceleration into second back handspring.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Direct connection with no hesitation | Spot beam throughout | Lock shoulders on hand block
Execution_Steps: 1. Perform first back handspring step-out with straight hand alignment. 2. Upon lead foot contact, immediately rebound into second back handspring. 3. Keep vision locked on center line of beam. 4. Step down into solid finished lunge.
Common_Faults: Hesitation or pause between handsprings (breaks connection) | Twisting off beam line
Video_Tutorial_Title: Back Handspring to Back Handspring Beam Series

Description: 1/2 turn onto vault table, violent hand block into backward tucked salto rotation landing firmly on 8" mat stack.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast sprint | Block through shoulders | Tight tuck rotation | Spot and stick
Execution_Steps: 1. Full sprint acceleration down runway into low board hurdle. 2. Turn 1/2 in pre-flight, contacting table in staggered hand placement. 3. Repel off table, pulling knees into chest in tight tuck. 4. Spot landing surface, open tuck, and stick landing.
Common_Faults: Low block height | Loose tuck | Taking steps on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Tsukahara Vault Tutorial & Drills

Description: Front giant on high bar, tap and release over bar into forward tucked/straddled salto, catching bar in swing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Violent heel drive on tap | Spot the bar throughout salto | Reach and catch with locked wrists
Execution_Steps: 1. Execute powerful front giant with undergrip on high bar. 2. Tap aggressively under bar, driving heels upward. 3. Release bar and flip forward in straddle salto over bar. 4. Catch bar in overgrip with arms extended and swing through.
Common_Faults: Late release peeling off bar | Closing eyes in flight | Bent arms on catch
Video_Tutorial_Title: Jaeger Release Bar Technique & Progressions

Description: Standing backward salto with 360° twist (full twist) executed directly from beam surface with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Set height first before twist | Tight wrap | Spot the line and freeze
Execution_Steps: 1. Stand on beam in plié with arms swinging back. 2. Explode vertically, setting chest and arms up to ceiling. 3. Wrap arms tightly to initiate 360° twist. 4. Spot beam at 270°, open body and stick landing on beam axis.
Common_Faults: Twisting off beam takeoff | Under-rotating twist | Landing off center
Video_Tutorial_Title: Standing Full on Beam Progression

Description: Round-off onto board, back handspring onto table, block into high layout with 360° full twist in post-flight.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Maximum speed | Fast board turn | Instant table block | Early landing spot
Execution_Steps: 1. High-speed sprint into round-off hurdle onto springboard. 2. Back handspring contacts table before vertical. 3. Violent shoulder repulsion into soaring layout post-flight. 4. Wrap for 360° longitudinal twist, spot landing and stick.
Common_Faults: Slow table contact | Twisting before table block | Piking on landing
Video_Tutorial_Title: Yurchenko Full Twist Technique Breakdown

Skill_Name: Full-In Back-Out Salto (Double Salto with Full Twist)
Description: High difficulty tumbling pass: round-off back handspring into double backward salto with full twist in first salto.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Massive set height | Fast twist in first salto | Open early to stick landing
Execution_Steps: 1. Maximum speed diagonal tumbling entry. 2. Punch floor vertically to ceiling with violent shoulder set. 3. Initiate full twist during first backward flip. 4. Complete second backward flip in tucked or layout shape, spot and stick.
Common_Faults: Low set leading to dangerous landing | Late twist | Landing off floor boundary
Video_Tutorial_Title: Full-In Back-Out Salto Breakdown on Floor
